portsSource.note: p.12 (logic terminals, unterminated cable); wire colours from MX392/MX393 user guide p.8-9, p.13 (shure/MX392-MX393-user-guide.pdf)

ports.label: Audio Out
ports.notes: Mic level, active balanced; attached 3.7 m (12 ft) unterminated cable: red = audio +, black = audio -, shield; 11-52 V DC phantom, 2.0 mA

ports.label: Switch Out
ports.notes: Mute button logic output (output only), white wire of the same cable; TTL, active low (<=0.5 V), sinks up to 20 mA; momentary or toggle (DIP 1); logic ground = green wire (tied to audio ground in the mic)

ports.label: LED In
ports.notes: LED control input (input only), orange wire of the same cable; active low (<=1.0 V), TTL; short to logic ground (green) to light the LED, e.g. from an automixer gate output (DIP 3 on)
